items.line: ずい ずい ずっころばし ごま みそ ずい

gloss.en: Nonsense finger-game: chased by the tea jar, slam the door; once it has gone by, off we go. The mouse in the rice bale eats and squeaks. Father may call, mother may call, we are not coming. Who chipped the teacup by the well?
